title: Midday Brief — Tue 24 Nov

stories.board: Chip stocks tumble a day after record jump
stories.headline: Tech stocks fall hard as Monday's Nvidia party ends
stories.what: The Nasdaq (a list of mostly tech companies) is down about 2 percent at midday, and Nvidia is down about 8 percent. Monday was the best day in many months after Nvidia brought back Jensen Huang as boss.
stories.why: Many retirement and savings funds hold these big tech stocks, so big swings move a lot of people's money.
stories.sides: No major disagreement; experts say investors are taking profits (selling to lock in gains) after a huge jump.

stories.board: Israel's top judge slams violent settler rioters
stories.headline: Israel's Supreme Court says violent settlers act like militias
stories.what: Chief Justice Yitzhak Amit said groups burning Palestinian fields and olive trees act like militias (armed private groups) and hurt Israel. The court ordered the army and police to explain under oath what they are doing to stop it.
stories.why: Israel's army chief also warned this violence harms Israel's safety, and it adds pressure on the government to act.
stories.sides: Centrist and left outlets stress the court's warning; right-leaning outlets report the court condemning rioters, while Defence Minister Katz says police, not the army, should handle it.

quick_hits: Israel says it hit a top Hamas security chief in Gaza City today; Palestinian reports say he was killed.
Jared Kushner, Trump's Middle East adviser, warned Israel could become a global pariah (a country others shun) if the Gaza plan stays stuck.
big_picture: After a wild Monday, markets cooled off, while Israel faces tough warnings from its own court and its US friends.
